hints.title: Compare Slope Equality Across Points
hints.text: All points lie on a straight line if and only if the slope between each point and the first point is identical.

hints.title: Use Cross Multiplication to Avoid Division
hints.text: Transform delta y / delta x equality into cross product equality: dx0 * (y - y0) == dy0 * (x - x0).

hints.title: Check All Points in a Single Loop
hints.text: Evaluate the cross product equation for every point; return false upon any violation, else true.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of points in coordinates
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Floating point slope division causes precision errors and division-by-zero on vertical lines.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Integer cross product calculation takes linear time and constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should avoid division and handle vertical/horizontal lines cleanly using cross multiplication.
complexity.notes: Coordinates contain at least two points.
